The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
Notification

IT is hereby notified that the notification issued by me in the exercise of powers vested in me by Article 43(1) of the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1933/13 of 21st, September, 2015 and amended from time to time, is further amended with effect from 28th March, 2018 in the manner set out in the Schedule below. Maithripala Sirisena, President. Presidential Secretariat, Colombo 01,28th March, 2018.Schedule

50. Minister of Law & Order
Column I
Duties & Functions
Column IIDepartments, Statutory Institu-tions & Public Corporations
Column IIILaws to be Implemented

1. Formulation of policies, programmes and projects, monitoring and evaluation in regard to the subjects of law & order and, those subjects that come under the purview of Departments, Statutory Institutions & Public Corporations listed in Column II
2. Maintenance of law and order
3. Implementation of strategies comprising broad reforms to establish social discipline
4. Adoption of necessary measures to improve efficiency of the police service on the advice of the National Police Commission
5. Take measures to prevent and combat various crimes and anti-social activities that have assumed the proportion of a social calamity
6. Control of vehicular traffic
7. Prevention and control of the use of dangerous drugs
8. Matters relating to all other subjects assigned to Institutions listed in Column II
9. Supervision of the Institutions listed in
Column II

2. National Dangerous Drugs Control Board
3. Training Schools for Youthful Offenders
